description:
Add one contact, or up to 500 at once. On a draft they are stored for
launch. On a running campaign they are sent now. A contact already in
the campaign is skipped, so a retry is safe. Each contact needs a
`phone_number`; every other key is kept and can fill a template
parameter through `variable_mapping`.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

campaign_id.description: Id of a WhatsApp campaign, from `listWhatsappCampaigns`.

requestBody.description: One contact object, or an array of 1 to 500.

oneOf.description:
One contact. `phone_number` is required. Any other key is kept on the
contact and can fill a template parameter through `variable_mapping`.

contact_name.description: A name for your team. `name` works too.

phone_number.description: The customer's number in international format, such as `+15551234567`.
